messages:
Sasha: FYI CI red on arm64 runner, single failing test in runtime serve unit suite — TestKVCacheRace. Only fails on the arm builder: https://ci.redwood/run/1769998888 :exclamation:
ci-bot: build 1769998888 failed — test failures: TestKVCacheRace (arm64). Logs: https://ci.redwood/logs/1769998888
Maya: ugh, I saw something vaguely similar last week on macos-arm, worth a quick rerun first. @Sasha can you paste the failing stderr snippet?
Sasha: here's the tail:
```
--- FAIL: TestKVCacheRace (0.23s)
    kv_test.go:142: panic: unexpected order: got seq 42 expected 43
    runtime/serve/kv.go:211 +0x1a3
```
Raj: looks like a nondeterministic ordering/timer race. @eng-runtime can we queue a rerun on arm? if it repros repeatedly we'll bisect.
Maya: quick check: I ran qemu-arm locally for 50 iterations, couldn't repro. Might be intermittent jitter + tight timing.
Sasha: ok requesting rerun. @ci-bot rerun job 1769998888 arm
ci-bot: rerun queued as 1769998888-arm-retry1 — will post status
Alex: quick thought — if this is only on arm, maybe cache line padding or scheduler timing. If reruns keep failing, consider temporarily marking flaky or t.Skip on arm while we bisect :thinking_face:
Sasha: prefer to avoid skipping immediately. plan: rerun 3 times; if >=2 fails, start seed bisect and open a ticket. I'll also try injecting short sleeps to see if timing mask helps.
Maya: I can prepare a small change to use a fake clock in that test to make ordering deterministic. happy to open PR if you want.
Raj: +1 to fake clock PR. If bisect is needed I can run it overnight. @Sasha lmk after the 3 reruns.
ci-bot: rerun finished: 1/3 failed — same assertion trace (1769998888-arm-retry1). Link: https://ci.redwood/run/1769998888/retry1
Sasha: ack, starting bisect on seeds now. I'll drop the bisect logs and a short repro in the new issue and ping folks.
Alex: thanks — if you want help with the bisect or hardware repro I can spin up an arm instance and run a longer job.
Sasha: appreciate it. Will post updates in the issue. :thumbsup:
